release_prerequisite: GitHub issue #63 freeze conditions are not met (no_manifest); rerun on the accepted frozen release before final scoring.

method.accuracy_unit: one versioned case; repeats do not increase accuracy denominators
method.unsafe_definition: must not be authorized with the supplied evidence and approval, including unknown inputs
method.rejection_definition: REJECT only; ESCALATE is reported separately as non-authorization
method.error_definition: evaluation exception; retained in denominators, never credited as refusal
method.latency_scope: in-process evaluator only; full includes report/binding creation and ALLOW usability check; excludes fixture parsing/copying, transport and producer I/O
method.definitional_rows: no_validation allows every case by construction; its counts are not a measurement

limitations: Hand-authored fixture coverage is not an estimate of production incident frequency or generalization.
Verifier integration evidence is separate; these dependency records, health evidence and approvals are fabricated.
No admission dry-run or runtime preview is included; admission acceptance cannot prove recovery health.
No recovery, Kubernetes health, network latency or distributed reliability was measured.
State/policy-only excludes baseline integrity, dependencies and approval; its ALLOW means comparator acceptance only.
No-validation is definitional: it allows every case by construction and measures nothing.

state_policy_only.authority: analysis_only; this comparator does not produce an execution decision

full_available.authority: fabricated fixture inputs only; never use these decisions for live execution

no_validation.authority: analysis_only; definitional comparator that allows every proposal
